title: Portfolio rework — recruiter home
brief: Recruiter home (/) for Alejandro Martín, 18-year-old junior backend developer. Clean modern base (terminal style reserved for /dev), real content from public/data, goal: a recruiter understands who he is in 30s and contacts him.

artboards.title: Editorial
artboards.tradeoff: Calm, credible, reads like a well-typeset CV with project case studies; least visual impact and needs scrolling to reach everything

artboards.title: Bento
artboards.tradeoff: Most visual and scannable, git-courer and the engram PR shine at a glance; risks looking like a template and gets busy with more content

artboards.title: Split sidebar
artboards.tradeoff: Identity, CV and contact always visible while scrolling; stacks on mobile and loses that advantage, quieter hero

artboards.title: Editorial + sidebar (mix 01/03)
artboards.tradeoff: Sticky identity/CV/contact from 03 with the editorial hero and problem/solution case studies from 01; no featured main project. Longest page; sidebar advantage lost on mobile

artboards.title: /dev — terminal interactiva + paneles
artboards.tradeoff: Interactive terminal (help, ls, cd, cat, neofetch, log, hire-me…) as the hero of /dev, plus terminal-skinned panels; scrollable page instead of the fixed 100vh dashboard. Lightweight DOM terminal instead of xterm: less authentic, much lighter
